research_question: Before training another boundary loss, do preserved explicit non-relevance judgments and the already-frozen post-PQ score actions jointly support broad protection of relevant Top-10 documents, promotion of relevant Top-100 candidates, and demotion of explicit non-relevant Top-10 documents?
scope: outcome-informed development feasibility only; no training, QAT, external evaluation, deployment, or method-success claim

novelty_guard.eligible_future_contribution: explicit-negative-masked, compression-consistent supervision for a compact residual sidecar over a fully frozen IVF-PQ index
required_future_ablations: matched v2.2 with the same explicit-negative mask
standard pairwise boundary ranking with the same mask
full v4 without unary negative penalty

data_policy.dataset: MS MARCO passage 1M historical development pool

v4_design_observed.allowed_use: label-schema, support, and action-space design gate

future_fp32_holdout.claim_status: procedurally sealed development holdout, not independent confirmation

data_policy.prior_access_disclosure: All MS MARCO queries in this phase were used historically for development, and the v3 design/audit positive-label outcomes are known. This phase is a prospective decision rule over a new label-semantics question, not an outcome-blind hypothesis test.
data_policy.external_claim_guard: No dataset may be called sealed or external confirmation until a project-wide repository, notebook, cache, and Drive access registry has been completed.

judgment_contract.positive_rule: a source judgment row exists and grade > 0
judgment_contract.explicit_negative_rule: a source judgment row exists and grade <= 0
judgment_contract.unjudged_rule: no source judgment row exists for the query-document pair

frozen_retrieval.candidate_source: exact v3 qrels-free candidate bundles inherited from the frozen v2.2 inner-train Top-100 arrays

progressive_primary.source: v3 design-frozen uncentered rank-32 SVD basis and global int8 scales

selective_exact_diagnostic.cost_unit: action count, not bytes and not a deployable representation

oracle_objective: maximize judged-positive count in final Top-10
among equal positive count minimize explicit-negative count in final Top-10
deterministic threshold and ascending document-ID traversal

metric_contract.primary_metric: macro mean Recall@10 over every role query with at least one judged positive
label_support: unary penalty queries with a judged-positive replacement

formal_decisions.INVALID_LINEAGE_OR_SOLVER: Any source, artifact, role, hash, candidate mapping, score, solver, chronology, or environment contract fails.
formal_decisions.STOP_UNDERPOWERED: The registered role does not meet the all-query sample-size floor.
formal_decisions.STOP_NO_EXPLICIT_NEGATIVE_SEMANTICS: The source does not preserve graded rows with explicit non-relevance, so unjudged candidates cannot be used as primary negatives.
formal_decisions.STOP_NEGATIVE_SUPPORT: Explicit negatives exist but coverage is below the registered query-level thresholds.
formal_decisions.STOP_NO_NOVEL_ACTION_SUPPORT: The unary penalty has too few queries with an explicit Top-10 negative and a judged-positive replacement to add supervision beyond v2.2.
formal_decisions.STOP_SWAP_SUPPORT: The label-only actionable swap ceiling is too small, sparse, or concentrated.
formal_decisions.STOP_NO_COMPRESSION_CONSISTENT_HEADROOM: The frozen post-PQ action oracle cannot recover broad label-supported gains with the required explicit-swap attribution.
formal_decisions.DESIGN_GO_TO_DIAGNOSTIC_AUDIT: All design checks pass; only the already-observed v3 audit role may be opened for a one-shot diagnostic.
formal_decisions.GO_FREEZE_FP32_DEVELOPMENT_PROTOCOL: All design and diagnostic-audit checks pass; this authorizes only a separately frozen FP32 development protocol on development data.

later_stage_guards.go_authorizes_only: a separately frozen, matched-baseline FP32 development protocol

prohibited_actions: editing this protocol after any v4 tri-state design result is observed
calling an absent qrel row an explicit negative
using binary candidate_relevance as the primary negative mask
excluding no-negative or no-swap queries from coverage denominators
materializing diagnostic-audit tri-state labels before a durable design GO freeze
opening future_method_holdout candidates, labels, support counts, or metrics in phase0
training, QAT, external evaluation, or deployment from a phase0 result
claiming protect-promote-penalize itself as a novel loss
trying unregistered datasets until one passes the label-support gate
